correctness.rationale: From the source’s first fixed-point equation, any feasible positive equilibrium obeys \(s^*=\mu^*(1-1/r-\mu^*)\), hence \(0<\mu^*<13/113\) when \(r=113/100\). On this interval, the positive terms of the source quartic satisfy \(H<292201/22600000\), while \(rv=226/15625\), with exact gap \(173427/113000000>0\). Thus \(Q=H-rv<0\) throughout the feasible interval. Exact rational replay also gives first-coordinate residual \(-16167/200000\) at the reported rounded pair \((0.33,0.0006)\). No numerical enumeration or asymptotic inference is used.

evidence: The Yang–Han source uses additive noise \(X_{n+1}=rX_n(1-X_n)+\varepsilon_n\) and its Figure 5 labels \(r=1.13\), \(v=0.0128\).
Wang–Wang use multiplicative noise \(X_{n+1}=rX_n(1-X_n)\varepsilon_n\) with \(E[\varepsilon_n]=1\) and \(E[\varepsilon_n^2]=v>1\).
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The multiplicative-noise model is not an equivalent reparameterization of the additive-noise map, so its equilibrium statements do not cover the printed additive-noise parameter inconsistency.

evidence: The article page labels Figure 5 with \(r=1.13\) and \(v=0.0128\).

The same numerical section states that at \(v=0.0128\) feasible positive equilibria occur approximately only for \(1.65<r<2.75\).
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: The source is the exact data/table/figure record being checked. Its own Figure 4 range is consistent with the exact nonexistence certificate and does not already formulate the contradiction as a correction.

originality.rationale: The source contains the ingredients of the contradiction: its feasibility theory and Figure 4 exclude the printed Figure 5 growth rate at the stated noise level, while Figures 5–6 assert positive-equilibrium validation. It does not identify or resolve that clash. The new contribution is the explicit source-specific inconsistency plus an exact rational nonexistence certificate; the closest inspected stochastic-logistic papers use different stochastic formulations or provide general closure theory and do not cover this correction.
residual_risks: The simulation code or data used for Figures 5–6 were not available in the inspected public text, so an unreported parameter value or caption typo could explain the discrepancy.
The claim therefore concerns the printed map and printed parameter labels only, not the authors’ unobserved computational intent.
